Edit the metadata draft of a collection.

Panel: [Collection](/docs/reference/cli/panels/collection/).

## Usage

```text
huron edit [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                               | Description                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron edit meta`](#huron-edit-meta) | Ask for each field of the schema. Start from the draft or the published metadata. |

## `huron edit meta`

Ask for each field of the schema. Start from the draft or the published metadata.

With `--file`, the CLI asks no questions. The JSON document becomes the draft without
changes.

```text
huron edit meta [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |

### Options

| Option           | Type | Default | Description                                                |
| ---------------- | ---- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--from-scratch` | flag |         | Start from an empty document.                              |
| `--file`         | path |         | Use this JSON document as the draft. Do not ask questions. |
